summary: Executed public-preview API regression tests and browser checks for landing, patient authentication, dashboard, directory search, notifications, legal navigation, logout, and mobile layout.

critical.issue: Double-booking prevention is not atomic: availability is checked before insert, but no unique database index or conditional insert is shown; concurrent requests can create duplicate appointments.

minor.issue: Admin availability path reads body.__dict__.get('doctor_id'), but AvailabilityCreate has no doctor_id field, so admins cannot set availability for a selected doctor.

issues: document scrollWidth exceeds viewport width, violating the no-horizontal-overflow requirement; likely caused by a fixed/negative-width visual or floating element in the mobile landing layout.

action_items: Fix mobile landing horizontal overflow at 390px.
Add doctor_id to admin availability input and enforce admin target authorization.
Add an atomic unique constraint/conditional booking operation for doctor/date/time to guarantee concurrent double-booking prevention.
critical_code_review_comments: Appointment booking relies on a check-then-insert sequence; the exception handler only helps if the database rejects a duplicate, but no unique index is created.
Admin availability is functionally broken because the request model drops doctor_id before the handler reads it.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (desktop core flow passed; mobile overflow failed)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created; used existing fictional demo accounts and doctors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth roles, /api/auth/me, invalid password, logout, protected routes, patient views, doctor directory/search, notifications, legal navigation, and desktop patient flow passed. Re-test mobile width, admin availability, concurrent booking, report upload/download authorization, and OAuth callback after fixes.
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow reproduced at 390px by asserting document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth on the landing page. Backend RCA is visible in server.py: AvailabilityCreate omits doctor_id while the admin handler attempts to read it, and book() performs slots() then insert_one() without a database uniqueness guarantee.
